window: 2004-2026 regular season; both estimators on the same games

collapse.reason: A wins pooled gate but no season supermajority
collapse.rule: pooled CI names a winner and that winner takes >= 2/3 of seasons; the collapse itself is an owner decision (DECISIONS.md)

estimators.A: pred_total_ensemble as published on lines.html (not retrained here)
estimators.B: mean of each team's up-to-5 most recent regular-season totals strictly before the game; league-mean fallback; zero fitted parameters
